Fields panel list with toggles (replaces Group by panel)

pattern.description: The cursor clicks the Fields toolbar button: Fields turns dark navy with a focus ring, Group by drops back to light blue, and the right-hand side panel swaps from the Group by settings to a wider Fields panel (search, fields in view, other fields with toggles) in one frame, narrowing the table.
pattern.why_premium: One click, one clear state change synced to 'and then I can quickly edit this'; the active-button colour moves with the panel content so viewers always know which control owns the panel.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.btn-fields', {backgroundColor: '#1d2b4f', color: '#fff', outline: '2px solid #0c66e4', duration: 0.04, ease: 'none'}).to('.btn-groupby', {backgroundColor: '#e9f2ff', color: '#172b4d', duration: 0.04, ease: 'none'}, '<').set('.panel-groupby', {display: 'none'}, '<').set('.panel-fields', {display: 'block'}, '<'); a designed recreation could add fromTo('.panel-fields > *', {autoAlpha: 0, x: 8}, {autoAlpha: 1, x: 0, stagger: 0.02, ease: 'power2.out', duration: 0.25}).
build_hint.remotion: Hard state switch at the click frame (conditional render keyed on frame >= click); button colours via interpolateColors over 1-2 frames. No spring.

notes: Instant UI swap (energy concentrated in 1-2 frames). The table also narrows because the Fields panel is wider than the Group by panel; no single candidate box isolates that reflow, so it is not listed separately.
